posts.titleMS: Cara membaca warna High / Medium / Low Impact
posts.summaryMS: Kategori impak berdasarkan jenis peristiwa. Warna tidak menjamin pergerakan USD atau emas.
posts.summaryEN: Impact class reflects typical event potential, not a guaranteed USD/gold move.
posts.bodyMS: CPI, Core PCE, NFP, kadar Fed dan data pekerjaan utama dikelaskan sebagai peristiwa yang lazimnya berpotensi impak tinggi. Industrial Production sederhana; pemerhatian seperti US2Y dan US10Y ialah konteks pasaran, bukan jadual berita. Tanpa konsensus dan masa keluaran yang disahkan, tiada kejutan Actual-versus-Forecast direka.
posts.bodyEN: CPI, Core PCE, NFP, Fed rate and major employment reports are typical high-potential categories. Industrial Production is medium. US2Y/US10Y are market observations, not scheduled releases. With no verified timestamp/consensus GoldFlow never fabricates an Actual-versus-Forecast surprise.
posts.qualityNote: Classification by event type only; direction is a conditional macro interpretation, not an instruction.

posts.bodyMS: Sumber MQL5 asal mempunyai ribuan baris, termasuk Telegram, pengiraan FRED/DXY as-of, live pre-close, fungsi scalp memory dan banyak corak. Port WEB STUDY ini hanya merangkumi subset yang dinyatakan, tidak menggunakan iCustom MetaTrader. A++ tidak diberi kerana data makro point-in-time belum disahkan. Penerangan entry adalah validasi penyelidikan, bukan transaksi broker atau kadar menang sebenar.
posts.bodyEN: The native MQL5 source includes Telegram, as-of FRED/DXY, pre-close studies, scalp memory and many additional patterns. This web study implements only explicitly described closed-candle portions; it does not read native MT5 iCustom buffers. A++ is blocked without verified point-in-time macro. Signals are research validation, not broker executions or real win-rate results.
posts.qualityNote: Native MQL5 source retained privately; compilation in MetaEditor and full output parity have not been certified.
